children.title: Service software update events

OpenSearch Service sends events to EventBridge when one of the following service software

children.title: Service software update available
children.summary: OpenSearch Service sends this event when a service software update is available.

children.title: Service software update scheduled
children.summary: OpenSearch Service sends this event when a service software update has been scheduled.

children.title: Service software update rescheduled

rescheduled.

children.title: Service software update started
children.summary: OpenSearch Service sends this event when a service software update has started.

children.title: Service software update completed
children.summary: OpenSearch Service sends this event when a service software update has completed.

children.title: Service software update cancelled
children.summary: OpenSearch Service sends this event when a service software update has been cancelled.

children.title: Scheduled service software update cancelled
children.summary:
OpenSearch Service sends this event when a service software update that was previously
scheduled for the domain has been cancelled.

children.title: Service software update unexecuted
children.summary: OpenSearch Service sends this event when it can't initiate a service software update.

children.title: Service software update failed
children.summary: OpenSearch Service sends this event when a service software update fails.

children.title: Service software update required
children.summary: OpenSearch Service sends this event when a service software update is required.

children.title: Auto-Tune events
children.summary:
OpenSearch Service sends events to EventBridge when one of the following Auto-Tune events
occur.

children.title: Auto-Tune pending
children.summary:
OpenSearch Service sends this event when Auto-Tune has identiﬁed tuning recommendations for
improved cluster performance and availability.

children.title: Auto-Tune started
children.summary:
OpenSearch Service sends this event when Auto-Tune begins to apply new settings to your
domain.

children.title: Auto-Tune requires a scheduled blue/green deployment
children.summary:
OpenSearch Service sends this event when Auto-Tune has identiﬁed tuning recommendations that
require a scheduled blue/green deployment.

children.title: Auto-Tune cancelled
children.summary:
OpenSearch Service sends this event when Auto-Tune schedule has been cancelled because there is
no pending tuning recommendations.
